artContract: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original production reward background for Reveal Line, a pixel-art FPV territory-capture game. Genuine deliberately chunky 16-bit pixel art: square clusters, crisp stepped edges, flat color ramps, recognizable silhouettes, modest detail, approximately 384-pixel logical horizontal resolution displayed large. Restrained field-kit palette: deep ink/navy #070b12, charcoal #101923, slate blue #425563, muted teal/green #687c55, off-white #f3f0db, warm amber #f4bf62 used sparingly; extend with a few controlled earth and sky ramps. Beautiful atmospheric composition that rewards revealing it, but no bloom, blur, texture noise, smooth painting, gradients, tiny speckles or photorealism. Quiet midground separates live gameplay from scenery. No text, logos, HUD, borders, icons, people, flying drones, propellers, active actors, capture lines, military insignia, weapons or UI. Art fills the full opaque rectangular canvas. One scene only, no panels or montage. This is a new original composition from the written brief, not a copy of another game. Keep important landmarks and open spaces legible as a small 240px gallery thumbnail.
